titleFormatted.en: Add activity monitor for [[device]], capability [[capability]], threshold [[threshold]] W, name [[name]]

hint.en: Continuity window and minimum confirmation start at 0 (off) here — tune them later with "Update activity monitor" if you notice fragmented or noisy cycles. Leave the threshold blank to auto-calibrate it instead: the monitor watches the device's power draw and sets its own threshold once it has enough history, firing "Threshold calibrated" when it does.
Leave blank to use measure_power. Other relevant capabilities on this device (current, energy, voltage) are detected and tracked automatically — no need to add them here.
Leave blank to auto-calibrate from the device's own power history instead of guessing a value.
